status: Proposed (X19). Every judge stays unverified until the capability probe (python -m evalv2.probe) has answered from it; nothing here has called a model.
note: Judge configurations by id. A run config selects one per slot in a task's options: {"judges": {"primary": <id>, "sensitivity": <id>, "continuity": <id>}}. A primary or sensitivity judge must come from a family distinct from every V2 subject and from the reference generator (evalv2.tasks.chat.scoring.check_judge_family). The continuity judge is V1's pinned judge (methodology.py: model, judge-prompt-v1, settings) and is used only to compare with V1; it shares the Omni and chat subjects' family by design and may judge only the incident kind. Changing a judge's model, endpoint, settings, parse rule or prompt changes its cache identity, so no cached verdict is reused. caps are hard ceilings per judge stage (one budget log per judge); a run config may only tighten them. Sources: adapters/catalog_rb1.json (listings, 2026-11-01), adapters/capabilities.json, experiments/pricing.json (V1 judge).

budget.approval: Owner approval of the third-family judge budget, relayed by the evaluation lead on 2026-11-01: gpt-oss-20b primary, mistral-large-4 sensitivity, at most 2,000 calls and about 3 M tokens in total. The caps of the judges listed here must not sum past it.
